profile.headline: Software Development Lead at CACI International Inc
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, articulate, and self-motivated senior full stack developer with agile methodology experience.  Team player who is able to easily pivot and refocus attention as needed. Ability to provide complex technical solutions while continuing to build positive customer relationships.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer for the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodology. PIEE is the primary enterprise procure-to-pay (P2P) application for the Department of Defense and its supporting agencies.

Primary responsibilities include Java based software development using object oriented design patterns and practices, leveraging the following technologies: Java, Angular, TypeScript, PrimeFaces, XHTML, XML, XSL, CSS, Oracle, SQL, SQL Developer, Elasticsearch, Kibana, JavaScript, JAXB, JSON, Junit, Scheduled EJBs, Ansible, JIRA, Git, Bitbucket, Subversion, SourceAnywhere, IntelliJ, Eclipse, WebSphere, Maven, EDI transaction sets, EDISIM, JSF, Spring, Bootstrap, jQuery

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer for DMLSS/LogiCole. LogiCole is the technical refresh of DMLSS transitioning all MEDLOG applications into a single, web-based application supporting all medical logistics functions in the Military Health System.

Primary responsibility was Java based software development using object oriented design patterns and practices, leveraging the following technologies: Java, Angular, TypeScript, Bootstrap, XHTML, CSS, MongoDB, Robo3T, JSON, JIRA, Git, WebStorm, IntelliJ, Maven
